results.title: India’s forex reserves stand at $780.78 billion despite global headwinds
results.description: The reserves had touched a record $785.71 billion in the previous week ended September 4, following a sharp increase of $44.90 billion. Before that, reserves had risen by $11.47 billion in the week ended August 28 to $740.80 billion.
